Do you have more than one promo, ending at different times?

A device credit that runs out in June and a bundle discount that runs out in December, for instance. Two end dates means two price changes.

With more than one promo running, the arithmetic stops being worth doing in your head. Easier to type each amount and how many months you pay it for, below.

Adding up your contract 0%

While we add it up, here is the whole idea.

  1. 1On your own, you get the individual price list. A discount to sign you, then the real rate once it runs out. No call, no letter, just a bigger number for the rest of the term.
  2. 2On Whollar, your street pools into one cohort. Providers bid for the whole block, and a block does not get quietly reset. One rate, no cheap half and expensive half.
  3. 3You take the best offer, or stay put. Switching fees are $0 by law, so the only way to lose is to not be in the room.
